info.name: SignalGen Admin — safe read checks
info.description: Read-only admin checks. Fill local variables privately; do not export real tokens. No account status, role, entitlement or subscription mutation is executed by this collection. See docs/backend/ADMIN_BACKEND.md for explicit manual status tests.

item.name: Admin list without login is rejected

exec: if(pm.response.code === 200) { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.test('bounded metadata', () => { pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(b.items.length).to.be.at.most(25); for(const item of b.items) { pm.expect(item).not.to.have.property('bio'); pm.expect(item).not.to.have.property('token_hash'); pm.expect(item).not.to.have.property('definition_json'); } }); pm.collectionVariables.set('accounts_after', b.next_cursor || ''); }

if(pm.response.code === 200) { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.test('only target metadata and string IDs', () => { pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an('array'); for(const item of b.items) { pm.expect(item.target_user_id).to.eql(pm.variables.get('target_user_id')); pm.expect(item.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(item).not.to.have.property('before'); pm.expect(item).not.to.have.property('after'); } }); pm.collectionVariables.set('audit_before', b.next_cursor || ''); }
